title: Intervención y Guerra Fría
goal: Read how all three conflicts became Cold War proxy wars -- the Contra war, the Iran-Contra scandal, the 1986 World Court ruling against the US, and Cuban/Soviet support for guerrillas in El Salvador and Guatemala.

items: Explain how the US began funding the Contras in 1981.
Explain what the Iran-Contra scandal revealed in 1986.
State what the World Court ruled against the US in 1986.
Describe Cuban and Soviet involvement in El Salvador and Guatemala.
Use a instancias de to name who pushed for an action.
